title: Evil Jerry
wikitext:
{{Historical article}} '''Evil Jerry''' is a mysterious character within Hypixel SkyBlock. They represents the counterpart of the joke villager [[Jerry]]. Little is known about them. They first appeared unexpectedly after the notice of a "bug/glitch" with the [[Unstable Dragon Armor]] smiting other players with unstable lightning strikes on public islands and one-shot killing them, with players losing their coins. This was either a real bug/glitch that occurred or the developers tried to troll the players. Their appearance is likely an easter egg within the Hypixel community with thoughts and ideas of an evil version of Jerry who is the ruler or trying to take over SkyBlock. === Quotes: === *One could say this game is... unstable!! == References == [https://hypixel.net/attachments/2020-08-19_00-27-31-png.1935175/ Capture 1]
